The two sections were read separately from their own card elements. Repeated games remain separate observations. Counts were not added across sections.
Lazy-loaded image DOM source URLs were observed, but no completed cover-file path or bytes were verified. Unknown file metadata remains null.
Five detail pages showed a browser-component error for running games while public metadata remained visible. No gameplay input or voting was performed.
